title: Testing Whether Emergent Misalignment Generalizes to Non-English Languages

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If misalignment generalizes cross-lingually, English-only safety testing is insufficient. If language-specific, multilingual evaluations are essential. Clear implications for safety evaluation practices worldwide.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Single finetuning run on existing English data, then inference-only evaluation with translated prompts. Translation of evaluation questions is manageable. Qwen models are multilingual by default. Highly accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One training run, evaluation in 2-3 languages. Deliverable is a clear comparison table. Translation of ~50 evaluation questions is feasible. Well-scoped for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
